source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Record the exact violations found, using technical terms and referencing specific safety standards (e.g., OSHA requirements).
3. Detail the conditions that led to the violations.
4. Include photos or videos of the violations, if available.
5. Note any injuries or near misses associated with the violations.
6. List the corrective actions recommended by the inspector.
7. Document any discussions or interviews with relevant personnel regarding the violations.
8. Record the time and date of the audit and the identity of the auditor or inspection team.
9. Detail any warnings or citations issued as a result of the audit.
10. Include a summary section, highlighting the most critical issues and potential impacts.
11. Maintain comprehensive records of all communications, including emails, memo exchanges, or verbal discussions related to the audit.
12. Ensure all documents are signed and dated by relevant parties, including auditors and company representatives.
13. Keep a follow-up log for tracking the completion of corrective actions
